description: This file defines the StreamInterceptor class, which implements a frame decoder interceptor for handling stream data in Spark's network client module. It manages stream data flow, handles exceptions, and interacts with message handlers and callbacks.

classes.name: StreamInterceptor
classes.description: A generic class implementing TransportFrameDecoder.Interceptor to handle streaming data, manage stream lifecycle, and invoke callbacks upon data receipt, completion, or failure.

methods.name: StreamInterceptor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the interceptor with a message handler, stream ID, byte count, and callback.

methods.name: exceptionCaught
methods.description: Handles exceptions by deactivating the stream and notifying the callback of failure.

methods.name: channelInactive
methods.description: Handles channel inactivation by deactivating the stream and notifying the callback of failure.

methods.name: deactivateStream
methods.description: Deactivates the stream if the handler is a TransportResponseHandler.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming ByteBuf data, reads bytes, updates state, and triggers callback methods on data, completion, or errors.
